collection.title: Hyundai Kona 2023 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Hyundai Kona (2023 Onwards) requires windscreen wiper blades to ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. The driver's side blade should be 26" in length, while the passenger's side blade should be 16". These windscreen wiper blades are specifically designed to fit the Hyundai Kona (2023 Onwards) model, which features a Hook type arm attachment for easy installation. To complete the set, we also offer a rear screen wiper blade for the Kona, which can be found by clicking on the rear screen wiper blade tab below. Trust our high-quality windscreen wiper blades to maintain excellent visibility and keep you safe on the road.
